title: The blanket in the bed
logline: The pup's bed under the table with the blanket in it, folded to hide the worn corner, and the pup, eleven, asleep with his chin on the fold. The page draws the fold.

panels.composition: A dog bed beneath a drafting table with a wool blanket folded into it, the worn corner tucked under, an old three-legged dog asleep with its chin on the fold, lamplight.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a dog bed beneath a drafting table with a wool blanket folded into it and an old three-legged dog asleep with its chin on the fold, lamplight, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
